text: old-rotation.ts is an orphaned file that serves a separate, unrelated purpose. It is explicitly legacy code ('Kept around in case we go back to the old rotation') implementing a different rotation scheme, not part of the flavor-of-day capability. This violates both 'No orphaned files' (nothing in the directory reaches it) and 'One capability per feature' (the directory contains two unrelated purposes).

The logic files do not follow the service conventions the spec incorporates: flavor.ts exports two free functions (todaysFlavor, announceFlavor) rather than a single run, returns plain strings instead of Results, and provides no consumer-grade failure handling (e.g., indexing into parlors with an empty list would throw rather than return an actionable error).

The error message for an invalid minReviews is "invalid input". The spec explicitly requires error messages to name what was wrong and what would be accepted instead (e.g., "rating must be a whole number from 1 to 5"), and explicitly calls out "invalid input" as NOT acceptable. The message should say something like "minReviews must be a whole number from 0 or greater".
